question: What purity arises from contemplating the stainless sky with mantra?
premises: The practitioner sits with a one-pointed gaze on the stainless, pervasive sky.
The practitioner remembers the mantra while doing so.
The verse rhetorically asks what purity could surpass this.
inference: Contemplation of the stainless sky with one-pointed gaze and mantra remembrance yields a supreme purity beyond comparison.
plain_english: When one sits in the stainless sky with a gaze made one-pointed on the pervasive expanse, remembering the mantra, what other purity could there be beyond that?
